sources.title: RedHatAI/SmolLM-135M-Instruct-quantized.w8a8: Model synced from source ...
sources.snippet: This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of SmolLM-135M-Instruct to INT8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%.
